source: doc-derived: Microsoft Foundry reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) how-to. NOT confirmed against a live fine_tuning.jobs.create submission -- treat the wire shape as provisional until a real RFT job validates it.
description: Language-neutral golden for the RFT reward-function (grader) schema, template namespaces, hyperparameter names, and dataset rules every castia SDK must reproduce. The eval rubric (id/description/weight) bridges into a score_model grader here (see rubric_to_score_model), tying the evaluate step to the switch-models step.

grader_types.notes: Exact/substring string comparison of two templates.
An LLM judge scores each sample. input is a list of judge-prompt chat messages. This is the target of the rubric bridge.
Sandboxed grade(sample, item) -> float; no network access.
Combine sub-graders via an arithmetic calculate_output expression over their keys.
Preview grader type; grade via an external endpoint.

dataset.row_shape: A chat messages[] list plus arbitrary extra top-level keys, which are the item.* ground-truth columns the grader reads.
rules: each row carries a non-empty messages[] chat list
the final message role MUST be user (RFT rolls the model's turn forward from the trailing user prompt)
extra top-level keys beyond messages are the item.* ground-truth fields
both a training split and a validation split are required
